meta.title: Various bid adapters: remove duplicative video param validations
meta.body_summary: Remove duplicative video parameter validations across multiple bid adapter modules in Prebid.js.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex removed redundant video validations across 7 adapters; github-actions duplication bot flagged remaining similarity and suggested extraction; PR quickly closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 441 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume, touching multiple adapter modules. The PR was closed without merge shortly after bot feedback, which is consistent with a rapid rejection due to incomplete deduplication approach.

review_details.concern_detail: A github-actions duplication checker flagged remaining duplicated lines between videobyteBidAdapter and yieldliftBidAdapter, and between dxkultureBidAdapter and yieldliftBidAdapter, recommending that common code be moved to a shared library rather than simply removing validations inline.
review_details.performance_claim: Removing redundant validation code may reduce overhead but no explicit performance claim was stated.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR was converted to draft and then closed by the author within roughly one hour after the bot feedback; no human review or further action was taken.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent removed duplicate code inline but did not extract shared functions as the project's duplication checker recommended. The project preference for a library‑based deduplication led to the PR being closed.

detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions[bot] ran a duplication check against the latest commits and reported that some adapter files still contained duplicated lines, urging extraction into a common library.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, before/after profiling, or reproducibility instructions were provided; the change only removed validation logic lines with no measurable performance evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge; no regression or fix cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Removed redundant video parameter validations (e.g., checking video object properties) from 7 bid adapter files, while AGENTS.md was added and later deleted during the PR's lifecycle.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: AGENTS.md was added with agent guidelines in early commits and then deleted before the PR was closed.
change_trajectory: Initial commits created and updated AGENTS.md with agent guidelines.

github-actions duplication checker commented on remaining similar code; PR was converted to draft and closed soon after.

review_signals.summary: Duplicated code audit repeated after a subsequent commit; same duplication lines and recommendation.
